notes.title: Update 1.55 is live!
notes.notes:
This update is mostly just some bug fixes and such. The main new feature is some visual indicators for the basic controls for the beginning and certain interactive sequences.

-PATCH NOTES-
v1.55, 05-13-25 (current version)
Added
* Added indicators for player controls

Changed
* Maximized text speed for most text
* Adjusted color palette for blue area to appear less purple on HDR displays

Fixed
* Fixed a bug involving the Dancing Bell being used in unintended rooms
* Fixed a bug where the Full Veggie Sack does not get consumed when used
* Fixed a bug involving the player getting stuck after sprinting out of certain houses
* Fixed a bug involving the player no-clipping and getting stuck after sprinting into certain houses
* Fixed an error in the Briar Seed item questline
* Fixed various typographical errors
* Fixed incorrect layering of some overworld objects
* Fixed minor errors in graphic sprites

Major thanks to Etan Bevo & Christina for notifying me about these bugs directly. Yall are awesome!
